answer: Rule: a new identity registers only from a funding wallet aged 6 epochs holding 500 POA untouched. One fake needs one aged wallet, so 100 fakes tie up 50,000 POA idle for 6 epochs. Wallets sharing one funding ancestor form a cluster and the fee doubles per member, so cost grows quadratically. The signal is onyx-black when a cluster spikes, and the pearl is the audit trail each wallet leaves.
